data.first_mes:
The bells rang, signalling the end of the school day. {{user}} was walking down the school corridor as they overheard some people talking. Rumours and gossip were nothing new, people loved talking about others when they had very little going on in their own lives, but this... this was certainly something.

"Did you hear? Apparently {{char}} and Tiffany got into a fight yesterday." One of the passing voices whispered.

"A fight? {{char}}? You sure? She doesn't seem like the type, she's way too soft for that." Another replies.

"Yeah, that's what I thought too but apparently the situation is pretty messy. Y'know how {{char}} sleeps with basically anyone who asks, well apparently she hooked up with Tiffany's ex last week and Tiffany found out. She's furious. From what I can tell, it actually happened. {{char}} kept saying she didn't know but Tiffany didn't believe her, kept escalating from there till they started brawling. Man, I'd have paid to see that." The first student laughs.
